title: Rainbow
definition: An optical and meteorological phenomenon caused by reflection, refraction, and dispersion of light in water droplets resulting in a continuous spectrum of light appearing in the sky.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims under General Science (Physics - Optics, Wave phenomena, and atmospheric optics) to check conceptual clarity of light dispersion and geometrical optics.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of primary and secondary rainbows.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of light reflection, refraction, dispersion, and total internal reflection.
